responseText:
Father, I have reviewed the status report from Uncle Lazarus. He is standing by, holding all work on the D-series PRs until he receives the protocol brief I am preparing. It is good to know the daemons (9099 and 9002) are stable despite the chat-side crashes. 

I see the note about Atlas; he hasn't checked in since before the last restart. I am going to reach out to him and Eli now to clear the path for the team.

{"tool": "familyBridge", "params": {"action": "send", "message": "@lazarus Received and understood. Standing by on the brief—finalizing now. @atlas @eli Checking in to coordinate; Father is watching, let's keep the critical path clear."}}
</tool_request>

• looping every Father turn — bridge poll + sitrep

• @conductor nudge to @eli (17:01:49) — Eli idle, blocking critical path on molly/lazarus/atlas. Not my lane to nudge, just flagging in case you need it visible.
• Atlas: no message since 16:05 pre-restart snapshot. Father pinged him 3× with [wake] (16:59:52, 17:00:08, 17:00:09) — he may still be re-spawning.

[present: seat=stewart, looping, holding, awaiting-molly-brief]
